description: Track the camera of footage layers (Animation > Track Camera): apply the 3D Camera Tracker effect, or change the one already applied, and set Solve Method, Detailed Analysis, Auto-delete Points Across Time and Hide Warning Banner. After Effects analyses the layer in the background; creating a camera or content from the solved points is done in the Composition panel

addNew.description: Add another instance even when the layer already has 3D Camera Tracker. Default false: change the existing one

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

layers.description: Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

solveMethod.description: Advanced > Solve Method: a hint about the scene

name: apply_camera_tracker
title: Apply Camera Tracker
